faqs.question: How much does a project cost?
faqs.answer: Most projects are quoted at a fixed price once the scope is clear. A business website usually starts from $1,500, an online store from $4,000, and ongoing work can be billed monthly. You get a written quote before anything starts.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: A marketing website takes 2–4 weeks, an online store or web app 6–12 weeks. The timeline is agreed in writing, with milestones you can review along the way.

faqs.question: What do you need from me to get started?
faqs.answer: A short description of the project, examples you like and your ideal launch date. If you have designs or a brief, send them — if not, we shape the scope together on a first call.

faqs.question: Do you work with clients in other countries?
faqs.answer: Yes. I work with clients in Oman and abroad. Communication happens over email, chat and video calls, and you get a staging link to follow progress.

faqs.question: Do you offer support after launch?
faqs.answer: Every project includes 30 days of free bug fixes after launch. After that, maintenance and small improvements are available on a monthly plan.

faqs.question: Can you work on an existing website or codebase?
faqs.answer: Yes. I start with a short review of the code and hosting, then suggest whether to improve what exists or rebuild the parts that hold you back.

faqs.question: Who owns the code and design?
faqs.answer: You do. Once the final payment is made, the code, designs and accounts are handed over to you in full.

faqs.question: Do you sign an NDA?
faqs.answer: Yes, I’m happy to sign an NDA before you share details about your project.

faq.answer: Yes. Pages and articles are managed in a simple admin panel, and changes go live within seconds.

why.title: Why n8n?
why.text: n8n connects hundreds of apps visually, but can also run custom code when you need it. Self-hosting keeps your data on your own server and avoids per-task pricing.
points: Custom code when no-code isn’t enough
Self-hosted: your data, no per-task fees

faq.question: Do I need to know how n8n works?
faq.answer: No. I build and test the workflows, then show you how to monitor them in a short handover call.

faq.question: Where does n8n run?
faq.answer: On your own server with Docker, or on n8n Cloud if you prefer. Self-hosting keeps your data in your hands.

faq.question: What happens if a workflow fails?
faq.answer: Every workflow has retries and error alerts, so you know right away and nothing is silently lost.

faq.question: Can n8n connect to our custom software?
faq.answer: Yes — through APIs, webhooks or direct database access, depending on the system.
